verdict.rationale: Docs show a clear meta-skill/spec workflow: SKILL.md format with required name/description fields, the built-in @plugin-creator skill that scaffolds .codex-plugin/plugin.json and MCP wiring, a recorder that drafts a reusable skill from a demonstration, and $skill-installer plus marketplace commands for packaging/distribution. Community evidence corroborates real-world authoring of custom skills for niche tools. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the full author-to-publish pipeline (e.g., actual submission-portal acceptance) and more detail on end-to-end testing/validation of a generated skill before packaging.
